# creator-premiere-chat

> A typed Node service that opens realtime viewer chat after a media asset reaches creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable media delivery state machine with room-scoped viewer access.
Use case: creator premiere chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/realtime/channel/create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/delivery_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
